title: Israeli Settlers Attack CNN and Other Journalists Near Sinjil, Four Arrested
detail: Israeli settlers attacked a CNN crew and other journalists near the West Bank town of Sinjil while they covered the one-year anniversary of the killing of Palestinian-American Saif Musallet, who was beaten to death by settlers in July 2025. Four settlers wielding wooden and metal rods, stones, and a knife blocked the journalists' vehicles, punctured a tire, smashed a windshield, and chased the group toward Sinjil before Israeli police and soldiers arrived. Police arrested four suspects and seized clubs and a knife from their vehicle.

media.caption: Israeli soldiers intervene near a West Bank settler outpost (file photo, July 2026 context) — the Times of Israel's coverage of settler violence near Sinjil
